author: (C. B. Adams, 1850)

note.en: A tiny pyramid snail of a few millimetres that lives as a parasite on other animals, known here only from museum specimens.
note.es: Un caracol pirámide diminuto, de pocos milímetros, que vive como parásito de otros animales, conocido aquí solo por ejemplares de museo.

evidence: GBIF: 4 records in the region (specimens and observations)
recWhy: Recorded: GBIF: 4 records in the region (specimens and observations).

marks.en: Tiny, very slender needle-like shell with many flat whorls.
marks.es: Concha diminuta, muy delgada, como aguja, con muchas vueltas planas.
